chapters.title: Once upon a time there were…
p: Once upon a time there were two friends, Steve and Susan.
Steve had a special surprise for Susan. He pulled out a big picture and gave it to her.
"What is this?" asked Susan.
"It's a picture of me," said Steve. "Do you like it?"
Susan smiled and said, "I love it!"
Steve smiled back. "Let's hang it up," he said.
The two friends went and hung the picture in Susan's room. It looked normal and fit perfectly on the wall.
Susan was very happy and thanked Steve for giving her the picture.
"You're welcome," said Steve. "I'm glad you like it."

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a man and his wife. He was strong and she was kind. Every day they worked very hard in the fields.
One day the wife said to her husband, “We should be humble.”
The husband nodded and said, “Yes, we should always remember to be kind to others and to be thankful for what we have.”
The couple worked hard every day and were happy in their life.
At the end of the day they came home and hugged each other. They thanked each other for being a good wife and husband.
The pair were truly happy and always remembered to be humble.

chapters.title: Molly was a little girl She…
p: Molly was a little girl. She was three years old and had bright, curly, blonde hair.
One day Molly was playing outside in the garden. She saw a big, black bird in the sky. Molly was so excited. She wanted to take a picture of it.
"Mama, can I have a camera?" Molly asked.
Mama said, "No, not right now, Molly."
Molly was disappointed, but she said, "Okay".
But then she had an idea. She saw a little ladybug and decided to take a picture of it instead.
Molly ran inside and demanded a camera from Mama.
Mama smiled and gave Molly a little camera. Molly took lots of pictures of the pretty ladybug, and then the big, black bird flew away.
Molly was so happy and thanked Mama for the camera. Mama was so proud of her little girl.

chapters.title: Once there was a bear who…
p: Once there was a bear who was feeling mysterious. He was walking through the woods when he saw something shiny. He thought, "What could this be?"
He walked closer and saw a boy sitting near the shiny object. Bear shouted, "What are you doing?"
The boy said, "I am thinking of a way to make my toy fly."
Bear was curious and he thought, "That is a mysterious thing to do." He asked the boy, "How do you think it will work?"
The boy tilted his head and said, "I don't know, but I think it will be fun to find out."
Bear smiled and said, "Me too." Then he waved goodbye and went back into the woods. He thought to himself, "That was a mystery worth exploring."

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was an old factory. It was very big and very noisy with all the machines running. One day a little girl decided to visit the factory. As she stepped inside, she looked around and saw all the workers busy folding and packing boxes.

Suddenly, the little girl got an idea and shouted, "I could help too!" The workers chuckled and told her to go ahead. So the little girl went to one of the station and started folding boxes alongside the workers.

The worker next to her was impressed and said, "You are so clever." The little girl cheered and told the worker, "Thank you. This is so much fun!" And just like that, the little girl and the workers had a happy time in the noisy factory.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a puppy called Tigger. He was a big, furry pup and liked nothing more than playing with his friends.
One day, he invited all his friends to his house for a special celebration and they all said yes!
When Tigger's friends arrived, he was so excited and barked for joy! Everyone had lots of fun and played together all day. They ran around the garden and played fetch with Tigger's favourite ball.

When it started to get dark, they all gathered in a circle and Tigger told everyone that it was time to celebrate. He said that it was time to take a paw and make a wish. Everyone held paws and closed their eyes. After a few seconds, everyone opened their eyes and shouted: "Hooray!"

Tigger had made sure that everyone felt safe and happy and all his friends said goodbye with big hugs. As they all headed home, they were still smiling and excited about the wonderful day they had shared.

chapters.title: John was playing in the park…
p: John was playing in the park. He saw a big puddle, and he went to it. He asked, "What's in the puddle?"
John's mom answered, "I think it's water!"
John stepped into the puddle and it was so messy. He laughed and said, "This puddle is fun!"
John's mom said, "Be careful, John. Don't jump too high or you'll get wet."
John answered, "Okay, Mom."
He splashed around in the puddle, having a great time. When he was done, he stepped out and said, "I had so much fun in the puddle! Can we go again tomorrow?"
John's mom smiled and said, "We can come back, but let's take our shoes off this time!"

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a litttle girl. She was only three years old, but she loved to sing and dance. Every day, she would spin and twirl around the garden, singing to herself.
One day, a big, scary spider crawled onto her shoulder. She was so scared and she ran all around the garden trying to get it off.
The spider said, "Why are you scared, little girl? I just want to dance!"
The little girl stopped and looked at the spider. She laughed and answered, "Ok, lets dance!"
So the spider started to dance. He did a spin and then a twirl with his eight legs. The little girl copied the spider, spinning around the garden.
At last, the spider said, "Now sing!"
So the little girl sang a happy song as she twirled and danced. The spider sang along, and they had a wonderful time.
When the song was finished, the spider thanked the little girl and said goodbye. She watched him run away into the bush and then she twirled off, singing and dancing her way across the garden.

chapters.title: One day Joe went to the…
p: One day, Joe went to the store. He was looking for something to repair his toy. The toy had an itch inside it, so Joe needed to fix it.
At the store, he saw a grumpy shopkeeper. Joe asked him for help.
"Can you help me repair my toy? It has an itch inside," said Joe.
The shopkeeper looked at the toy and said, "Yes, I can help you. I have the right tools." He fixed the toy in no time.
Joe thanked the shopkeeper and said goodbye. He was so happy that his toy was fixed. Now he could play with it again.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there were…
p: Once upon a time there were two friends named Jack and Jill. They wanted to have a good time so they decided to go to the theater for a movie.
At the theater, Jack and Jill got their tickets and went inside. The theater was very big and there was a big screen up front. They sat down in comfy chairs and waited for the movie to begin.
The movie started and Jack and Jill began to watch. It was a very fun movie and they both laughed and smiled throughout.
At one point during the movie, a voice from the back of the theater said, “Stop the movie! We need to record something.”
Jack and Jill looked around and saw a man with a camera. He was recording the movie for a good reason.
The man said, “We are recording this scene for a documentary. It’s for a good project that will show people how much fun it is to go to the theater.”
Jack and Jill smiled and waved at the man with the camera. Then they went back to watching the movie and having a good time.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there were…
p: Once upon a time, there were two friends, Jack and Jill. They were very friendly and loved to play together.
One day, Jack and Jill were playing together when suddenly Jack noticed something strange.
Jack said, “Jill, look. All the people around us are speaking different languages.”
Jill looked around and said, “Wow, that is so amazing! Can you understand them?”
Jack thought for a moment, “No, they all sound very separate.”
Jill smiled, “Let's join them. They look friendly and maybe they can teach us something new.”

Jack agreed, and soon they were learning new words and having fun with the people around them. They soon realised that even though different languages can separate people, it can be fun and exciting to learn about each other.

chapters.title: Mia was looking at the house…
p: Mia was looking at the house decorations. They were so colorful and she wanted to decorate too. She asked her mom, "Can I decorate too?"
"Yes you can! Let's go get the decorations!", her mom said with a smile.
Mia was so excited. She wanted to make her house look pretty.
Mia and her mom went to the store and bought colorful streamers, balloons, and paper lanterns. Mia was so happy when she saw all the decorations and couldn't wait to decorate.
They got home and Mia started decorating. She hung up the streamers and paper lanterns. She was feeling proud of her work. She thought it looked so beautiful.
When Mia's friend saw the decorations, she was envious. She said to Mia, "Your decorations look amazing!"
Mia smiled and said, "I love decorating and it was so much fun!"

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a plane that flew high in the sky. It was so high, that it almost looked as small as a toy.

One day, the plane was making a journey over a mountain. Suddenly, the sky became very dark and the wind became very harsh. The plane shook, and the pilot knew he had to do something quickly. "We have to drop down to a lower altitude!" He shouted to the passengers. Everyone agreed that this was the best thing to do.
So, the plane dropped lower and lower. Finally, it got to the other side of the mountain and the air became calmer. The pilot and the passengers were very happy.
The end.

chapters.title: Davey was a little boy He…
p: Davey was a little boy. He was only three years old. One day, Davey was very thirsty. He went to the kitchen and opened the fridge. Inside the fridge, he found an empty milk jug. He sighed and closed the fridge.
Just then, Davey heard a voice. "Hey Davey, let's go get some milk for the jug!" It was Davey's mom. She was smiling at him. Davey smiled back. He was happy to go out with his mom.

The two of them drove to the store. Inside the store, Davey saw a big glass jug filled to the top with milk. He was so excited that he started to clap. His mom smiled and said, "Come on, let's get some milk". She urged Davey to the cash register and they paid for the milk.

Every step of the way home, Davey's mom urged him to hurry. When they got home, Davey carefully poured the milk into the empty jug. He put the jug back in the fridge and his mom hugged him. Davey was so happy that he got to go on an adventure with his mom and fill the empty milk jug!

chapters.title: Once there was a person The…
p: Once there was a person. The person was gentle and liked to talk. One day, this person was walking in the street and they saw a little girl. The person stopped to talk to the little girl.
The person smiled at the little girl and said, "Hello! What is your name?".
The little girl smiled back and said, "My name is Patricia".
The person said, "That's a very pretty name! What are you doing?".
Patricia said, "I'm playing with my dolls".
The person smiled and said, "Oh, how fun! Can I join you?".
Patricia said, "Sure! Let's play together!".
The person and Patricia played together for a long time. They talked and laughed. They had so much fun! When it was time to say goodbye, the person gave Patricia a gentle hug and waved goodbye.
Patricia waved back and said, "Goodbye! Come back and play soon!".
The person smiled and said, "I will! Goodbye, Patricia".

chapters.title: Tammy was 3 years old One…
p: Tammy was 3 years old. One day, when she was playing outside, she saw something sparkly on the ground. She picked it up and saw that it was a mineral. She didn't understand what it was, so she asked her Mom.
"Mom, what is this?"
"That is a mineral, dear," Mom said.
"What does it do?" Tammy asked.
"Well," Mom said, "it doesn't do much. It's just a silly rock."
Tammy smiled and put the mineral back where she found it. She was glad to have understood what it was.

chapters.title: Once there was a boy He…
p: Once there was a boy. He was only three years old and he loved to fix things. One day he found a broken whistle. The boy was excited. He decided he would try to fix it.
He looked carefully at the whistle, making sure he could remember what it looked like before it broke. Then, he got to work. He found some string and glued the whistle back together.
When he was done, the boy blew into the whistle and it worked! It made a beautiful sound.
The boy's mom came in and said "What did you fix?"
The boy proudly answered "I fixed the whistle!"
His mom smiled and said, "That sounds beautiful."
The boy thanked his mom and ran outside, whistle in hand, to share his new whistle with all his friends.

chapters.title: Once there was a busy little…
p: Once there was a busy little girl called Sally. She loved to stretch and move her body.
One day, Sally was at the park with her family. Her mum said it was time for Sally to play some baseball.
Sally excitedly skipped over to the pitch. She saw a group of other children playing there.
"Can I join you?" Sally asked.
The other children smiled. "Yeah!" they said.
So Sally joined the game. She moved around the pitch, stretching her arms and legs. She had so much fun playing baseball with her new friends.
The game ended and Sally ran back to her family. Her mum smiled and said, "Well done, Sally!"
Sally was so happy. She had had a really busy but fun day.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was an old broken horse, who lived in the stable on the farm.
He was lonely, every day he peered out of the stable window hoping to see some activity, but all he saw were the chickens scratching in the dirt.
One day, the horse peered out of the window and saw a small girl, wearing a pretty red dress.
She saw the horse and called out to him.
"Hi Horse!" she said.
The horse was so excited, he whinnied and shook his mane in delight.
The girl opened the stable door and walked inside.
"Can I give you a hug?" she asked.
The horse nodded, and the girl gently wrapped her arms around the horse's neck.
The horse closed his eyes, he was so happy to finally have a friend.
The girl and horse became the best of friends, they played in the paddock and galloped around the farm. For the first time, the old broken horse felt loved.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a girl named Jane. She was outside playing on the swing. She saw a bright shooting star and she yelled out in excitement.
"Look, Mom! A shooting star!"
Her mom smiled at her and said, "That's amazing, Jane. Wish something special!"
Jane thought for a moment and said, "I wish for a swing that glows in the dark!"
Her mom said, "That's a great wish! Let's see if it comes true!"

The next day, Jane and her mom went outside and Jane's eyes sparkled bright. There was a magical swing made of stars that glowed in the dark. Jane ran and jumped onto it, feeling like the luckiest girl in the world. She shot up higher and higher in the sky, reaching for the stars just like the shooting star she had seen the night before.

Jane and her mom had so much fun together on the magical, glowing swing. They played under the stars and laughed until the sun came up. Jane will never forget that night and the special wish that had come true.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little boy named Tim. Tim was only three years old. One day, Tim's mommy made him a nice bowl of his favorite soup. Tim took a big bite and then he went to watch his favorite film.
The film was about a big, scary monster. It made Tim so scared that he started to weep. Mommy heard Tim's cries and ran into the room.
"Oh no, why are you crying Tim?" asked Mommy.
"The film was too scary," said Tim.
Mommy hugged him tight and said, "It's okay, Tim, it's just a film. There are no real monsters. You are safe."
Tim smiled and mommy wiped his tears away with a tissue.
Mommy tucked him into bed and said, "Good night, Tim. Sweet dreams."
Tim closed his eyes and soon he was sound asleep.

chapters.title: Once there was a little girl…
p: Once there was a little girl named Suzie. Suzie was three years old and loved to play outside in the sun.
One day, Suzie wanted to go outside and swing on the swing, but mum said no. She was worried about the big wind outside.
"It's too windy today. You can't go out," said mum.
"But I want to swing," said Suzie.
Mum smiled and said, "Let's call Grandma. Maybe Grandma can come over and play with you inside. Would you like that?"
Suzie smiled. "Yes, please call Grandma," she said.
So Mum called Grandma and soon Grandma was there. She brought a game with her and they all played together. Suzie felt dizzy when she spun around and around, but she had lots of fun with Grandma.
Mum was relieved that Suzie was having so much fun and that she wasn't worried or sad with the wind outside.
At the end of the day, they all had a big hug and Suzie said, "Thank you for coming, Grandma!"
Grandma smiled and said, "You're welcome, Suzie!"

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a boy who was very eager. He urged his dad to go on a walk together to a nearby park. His dad said yes, he was thoughtful and could see his son's enthusiasm.

When they arrived at the park, they both played happily on the swing, the seesaw and the slides. But after a while, the boy's stomach started to grumble. He urged his dad to go home for dinner. His dad, being thoughtful, agreed and promised a bigger adventure tomorrow.
When they arrived at home, delicious smells filled the entire house. The boy sniffed the air and urged his dad, "Let's have dinner!" His dad laughed and promised a big surprise, later.
They both sat down at the table, and the boy's eyes widened when he saw what his dad had prepared. It was his favorite food! He thanked his dad for being so thoughtful.
"It's so good, Dad!" he said, with a mouthful of food. His dad smiled and replied, "Let's enjoy it while it's still hot!"
And so they did. The boy was full and happy, and thanked his dad once again for the thoughtful dinner.

chapters.title: John had a kayak He wanted…
p: John had a kayak. He wanted to fix it up. He was so organized. He found a tool kit and all the supplies he needed.
John smiled. He was ready to start. He grabbed the glue and put it on the kayak. Then he grabbed the hammer.
John's dad noticed his hard work. "Good job, Johnny!" said his dad. "How else will you repair the kayak?"
John thought for a moment. He grabbed the screws and put them in the holes. He tightened them with the screwdriver.
John's dad clapped. "Now, Johnny, you're all done! Your kayak is all repaired."
John jumped for joy. He was so happy. He had fixed the kayak in no time. He thanked his dad for helping. He was so proud of his work.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. She was only three years old. She was very excited to start a new task.
When Jane's mom handed her the task, she couldn't believe how thin it was! She asked her mom, "What is this?" Her mom said, "It's a very special task for you. I want you to try your best."
Jane said, "I'll try my best!" She was determined to do well so she worked hard on the task. Jane used colors and shapes to make something beautiful.

Finally, she was done and she handed her mom the task. Jane's mom looked at it and smiled. She said, "You did a great job, Jane. I'm so proud of you!" Jane was so happy with herself. She couldn't believe she had done such a wonderful job.
Jane smiled and said, "Thank you. I love this task."
